anchor.semantic_hook: Everything indicating one conclusion is made visible by every movable object physically pointing toward the same evidence platform.
anchor.setting: A quiet evidence room contains a round central platform, plain tables, chairs, lamps, compasses, and clock faces without digits. anchor.absurd_element: every object in the room independently turning to point toward one platform
